reading.body:
Google operates a data center campus in Berkeley County, South Carolina that it acquired as one of its original long-running US sites. The company does not publish power capacity, square footage, or building-level specifications for this facility, disclosing only aggregate investment figures at the state level. Google announced a $500 million expansion specific to this Moncks Corner location as part of a combined $3.3 billion investment across two South Carolina campuses in September 2024.

This campus's individual power capacity is not disclosed by the operator. South Carolina as a state has 14 mapped data center facilities, of which only four publish megawatt figures in operator specifications, totaling 6.6 MW published across the state. Without published capacity for the Berkeley County site, its contribution to the state total and its rank among facilities cannot be determined from operator disclosures alone.

The $500 million Moncks Corner expansion signals Google's continued investment in this location but provides no basis to compare its scale to other AI-capable campuses. The absence of published specifications for individual buildings at this site reflects Google's standard practice of withholding facility-level technical data in favor of aggregate state-level announcements.
